trajectory_summary: This is a short, low-friction call that ends in disqualification once the customer reveals she already has an existing solar system and was actually calling about a broken solar-powered refrigerator, not a new install. The rep handled the mismatch honestly but closed the call immediately without running any orphaned-system qualification questions, leaving a possible probing opportunity unexplored.
outcome_dispute: The dq/no_appointment outcome itself is correctly called — the rep did not book and the customer's stated need falls outside Ion's offerings. However, this should be read as a process gap rather than a contested outcome: the rep skipped the orphaned_flow script entirely (existing system ownership, company, working status) before disqualifying, so the DQ was made on incomplete information about whether a new legitimate solar-and-battery quote could still apply to this address.
